business_problem: Tongji University needed a domestic AI stack with stronger computing and model-tooling support for embodied intelligence, multimodal models, autonomous perception and multi-agent research.
solution_summary: Tongji University and Baidu AI Cloud built a domestically based embodied-intelligence large-model development platform that combines Kunlun P800 accelerators, the BaiGe heterogeneous-compute platform, the Qianfan model platforms and the Yijian vision-model platform. Rather than using these components separately, Tongji assembled them into a one-stop research environment for tuning, adapting and evaluating large models in embodied-intelligence, autonomous sensing and software-engineering scenarios. The system supports deep adaptation of ERNIE and DeepSeek series models, then exposes model-effect tuning toolchains and research application capabilities to university projects. That lets Tongji use one governed infrastructure base for research and teaching in robots, drones, smart-city sensing, multi-agent coordination and embedded software. The platform is therefore both an academic compute substrate and a reusable model-development environment: it helps the university manage specialized training and inference work while also supplying a common stack for talent development and cross-domain software education.

solution_components.name: Kunlun P800
solution_components.role: Provides the domestic accelerator foundation for large-model development and embodied-AI workloads.

solution_components.name: BaiGe AI Heterogeneous Compute Platform
solution_components.role: Schedules and optimizes heterogeneous compute resources for research workloads.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Packages embodied-intelligence research applications on top of the platform.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Provides the model tuning and toolchain foundation for Tongji's research models.

solution_components.name: Yijian Vision Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Adds vision-model capabilities to the embodied-intelligence research stack.

data_flow: Research data and model experiments are scheduled across Kunlun and BaiGe resources, tuned through the Qianfan toolchain, and then surfaced into embodied-intelligence applications for robots, drones and smart-city sensing research.
business_outcome: Tongji gained a domestic full-stack research platform that speeds model tuning, supports embodied-intelligence applications and reinforces teaching programs in intelligent software and urban sensing.
architecture_clues: The platform combines compute, language models and vision models in one stack
ERNE and DeepSeek models are adapted inside the same environment
The same platform serves research and teaching use cases
evidence_quotes: Tongji selected Kunlun P800, BaiGe, Qianfan and Yijian to build a fully domestic embodied-intelligence large-model development platform (original: 项目方案选用性能卓越的昆仑芯P800、百度百舸AI异构计算平台、百度智能云千帆大模型平台、百度智能云一见视觉大模型平台进行融合).

Tongji and Baidu deeply adapted ERNIE and DeepSeek series models and formed both a large-model R&D platform and a research-application platform (original: 同济大学与百度智能云基于昆仑芯P800与文心大模型及DeepSeek系列模型深度适配，并基于百度智能云千帆大模型平台，形成了具身智能大模型研发平台和具身智能科研应用平台).
